failure: Failure: Does not prove or refute Frankl, does not establish S or C, and does not show every approach to those inequalities is impossible. The n<=5 enumeration and independent implementation were described but their code and receipts were not attached or rerun.
interface: Interface: Finite family of subsets of [n], closed under pairwise union and containing a nonempty set; X is uniform on F, c_i and p_i are coordinate frequencies. Entropies are in bits. Assertions S and C are candidate sufficient inequalities only, not established theorems.

claims.title: Two unproved global inequalities would imply Frankl, while proposed precursor arguments fail
